expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Planned v2 work will expand the protocol with optional request IDs for correlating messages, timestamps for creation time or ordering, and payloads for carrying application data, while preserving the existing Ping message and roundtrip behavior for compatibility.

Shipped v2 Hello with an explicit version 2 envelope and roundtrip-compatible encoding and decoding.
